Specification: This module is a TLC-oriented regression test for TLA+ function domains, function sets, DOMAIN, SUBSET, Cartesian products, tuples, records, and finite-set cardinality. It models a trivial one-variable state machine where x is a Boolean constant state that never changes, while the main logical content is an invariant Inv containing many IF-THEN-ELSE checks that call Assert and Print to validate expected semantic behavior. The spec exercises membership in function sets, domains of function constructors, record domains as sets of strings, tuple membership in function sets, multi-argument function constructors with product domains, and cardinality computations over finite domains.
